questions.question: Who was sleeping between the Hatter and the March Hare?
questions.explanation: 帽匠和三月兔喝茶时，睡鼠坐在两人中间睡着了。

questions.question: How did the Hatter and March Hare greet Alice at their table?
options: They invited her to the Queen's party
They gave her a new chair
They said there was no room for her
They asked her to tell a story
questions.explanation: 明明桌子很大，两人却喊着没有她的位置。

questions.question: Why did the Hatter's watch not work properly?
options: It had fallen into the river
Butter and bread crumbs had been put inside it
questions.explanation: 三月兔试图用黄油修表，还把面包屑弄了进去。

questions.question: What did the Hatter say Time could do for a friend?
options: Move the clock ahead to lunchtime
Turn a cat into a pig
questions.explanation: 帽匠说若和时间是朋友，就能让上课时间一下变成午餐时间。

questions.question: Why did the Hatter say it was always six o'clock?
options: Time stopped helping him after the Queen accused him of murdering time
His watch had no minute hand
The Dormouse kept changing the clocks
He forgot to wind his watch
questions.explanation: 王后在音乐会上说他谋杀了时间，时间便不再帮助他。

questions.question: Why were there so many place settings at the tea table?
options: They were expecting a hundred visitors
They could move to clean cups because it was always teatime
They wanted to sell the cups
questions.explanation: 总是下午六点，没有时间洗碗，大家便换座位使用干净餐具。

questions.question: Who was asked to tell a story after Alice said she knew none?
questions.explanation: 爱丽丝说自己不会讲故事，于是大家叫醒睡鼠。

questions.question: Where did the three sisters in the Dormouse's story live?
options: At the bottom of a well
questions.explanation: 睡鼠讲的三个姐妹住在井底。

questions.question: What did the Dormouse say the sisters lived on?
questions.explanation: 睡鼠说三姐妹靠糖蜜生活。

questions.question: Why did Alice leave the tea party?
options: She had received an invitation from the Queen
She was tired of the others' rudeness and nonsense
questions.explanation: 帽匠的无礼让她无法忍受，于是愤然离开。

questions.question: How did Alice finally enter the beautiful garden?
options: She followed the Mouse through a tunnel
She unlocked the door and used mushroom to shrink
The King opened a gate for her
questions.explanation: 她先开锁，再吃蘑菇缩小，终于进入花园。

questions.question: Why were the gardeners painting white roses red?
options: They had planted white roses by mistake and feared the Queen
questions.explanation: 王后要红玫瑰，他们错种白玫瑰，担心被砍头。

questions.question: How did Alice respond when the Queen threatened her?
options: She gave the Queen some candy
She asked the Rabbit for help
questions.explanation: 爱丽丝大声说胡说八道，没有屈服于王后的威胁。

questions.question: How did Alice protect the three gardeners?
options: She sent them through the rabbit hole
She hid them in a flowerpot
She asked the Hatter to rescue them
questions.explanation: 她将害怕的园丁藏在花盆中躲避士兵。

questions.question: What did the Queen invite Alice to do at the end?
questions.explanation: 王后问爱丽丝会不会打槌球，并让她随队同行。

questions.question: Why was the Duchess in danger of execution?
questions.explanation: 白兔说公爵夫人因打了王后的脸而被判死刑。

questions.question: What served as the croquet balls?
questions.explanation: 槌球比赛的球竟然是活刺猬。

questions.question: What did the players use as croquet mallets?
questions.explanation: 大家用火烈鸟充当槌球杆。

questions.question: Why did Alice have difficulty playing the game?
options: The live animals would not cooperate and players played unfairly
She was too small to reach the lawn
questions.explanation: 火烈鸟和刺猬不听使唤，球员还不轮流打，比赛非常混乱。

questions.question: What did the Queen order after the King wanted the Cheshire Cat removed?
questions.explanation: 王后仍然只会喊砍掉他的头。

questions.question: Why were some players threatened with execution?
options: They had stolen the Queen's roses
They were late to the tea party
questions.explanation: 白兔说那些人因为不专心错过轮次而被王后处罚。

questions.question: What problem did the Executioner have with the Cheshire Cat?
options: The Cat was hiding in the river
Only the Cat's head was visible and there was no body to behead
questions.explanation: 刽子手说只有头没有身体，自己从没砍过这种头。

questions.question: Whom did Alice suggest asking about the Cheshire Cat?
questions.explanation: 爱丽丝提醒众人柴郡猫属于公爵夫人。

questions.question: What happened before the Executioner returned with the Duchess?
questions.explanation: 刽子手回来前，柴郡猫已经完全消失。

questions.question: What did the Queen order the Duchess to do?
questions.explanation: 王后见到公爵夫人后命令她立刻离开。

questions.question: What happened each time the Queen ordered someone's head cut off?
options: The King gave them a prize
A soldier took that person to prison
questions.explanation: 王后每次喊砍头，都有士兵把那人带去监狱。

questions.question: Why did the croquet game become impossible to continue?
options: Almost all the players were imprisoned and the wickets were gone
questions.explanation: 球员几乎都被关进监狱，充当门的士兵也走了。

questions.question: What did the King plan to do while the Queen left the lawn?
questions.explanation: 爱丽丝听到国王说要去监狱赦免所有人。

questions.question: Which creature did the Queen order to take Alice to the Mock Turtle?
questions.explanation: 王后命令鹰头狮身兽带爱丽丝去见假海龟。

questions.question: What did the Gryphon tell Alice about the Queen's threats?
options: The Queen would punish Alice next
The Executioner never actually cuts anyone's head off
The King ordered all the executions
questions.explanation: 鹰头狮身兽说王后的处刑想法都是她自己想象出来的。
